overview: Euclid DR1 strong lensing continues to dominate, with the ECLIPSE catalogue of 15,072 candidates, a transformer-CNN segmentation pipeline for mass modelling, and a CNN ablation study. Benchmarks released include COSMIO for cross-survey imputation (LSST/Euclid/Roman) and the FAIR Universe weak-lensing uncertainty challenge. Method work spans normalizing flows for DESI DR1 tomographic N(z), field-level generative corrections, neural-operator and UNet surrogates for MHD turbulence and rotating neutron stars, neural posterior estimation for gravitational-wave tests of general relativity, and equivariant spherical Fourier neural operators.
